verdict.rationale: Pomelo's guides include a first-party capability to create users and validate their identity before they can operate, so some cardholder verification is built into the platform. That evidence is a single one-line guide summary. Missing for 10: KYB for business cardholders, documented KYC data requirements, review/verification states, re-verification flows, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, cardholder verification is built into issuance — KYC for consumers and KYB for businesses run through the platform with documented data requirements, review states, and re-verification flows

citations.quote: Crea usuarios y valida su identidad para que puedan operar.
